[ASSISTANT_SAID] Sushi recommendations for beginners include California Roll, Salmon Sashimi, and Temaki (Hand Roll).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ingredients needed for sushi include sushi rice, nori, fresh fish or imitation crab, vegetables (cucumber, avocado, carrots), rice vinegar, sugar, salt, soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for beginners include using short-grain Japanese rice, preparing ingredients in advance, watching online tutorials, and practicing rolling techniques.  
[PREFERENCE] User has been experimenting with different flavors and ingredients in cooking, including adding Korean chili flakes for extra heat.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Korean chili flakes (gochugaru) can be used in kimchi, spicy stir-fries, marinades, soups, and as a seasoning blend.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Simple Korean recipes suggested include Bulgogi, Kimchi Fried Rice, Japchae, Tteokbokki, and Korean-Style Fried Chicken.  
[PREFERENCE] User has chosen to start with the Bulgogi recipe.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Simple Bulgogi recipe provided includes ingredients: 1 lb beef, 2 cloves garlic, 1/2 cup soy sauce, 1/4 cup gochujang, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tbsp sesame oil, 1 tsp ground black pepper, 1/4 cup chopped green onions, and sesame seeds for garnish.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for Bulgogi include marinating the beef, grilling or cooking it, and garnishing with green onions and sesame seeds.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations for Korean chili paste (gochujang) brands include Sempio, Kikkoman, Chongga, and Samyang.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] When shopping for gochujang, look for a thick, sticky consistency and deep red color.
